newsitem.title: UK: Ethical says first-half losses narrow.
newsitem.headline: Ethical says first-half losses narrow.

text.p: British-based drugs group Ethical Holdings Plc said on Thursday that its operating losses in the six months to February 28 narrowed slightly to 2.7 million stg from 3.0 million a year before.
The company, which is listed on the U.S. Nasdaq exchange, said revenues rose 29 percent to 6.3 million stg, while spending on research and development rose 20 percent to 5.5 million stg.

The company said the UK launch of its combination skin patch for Hormone Replacement Therapy (HRT), which is being marketed by Schering Health Care Ltd took place after the end of its second quarter, and so sales are not reflected in the results.
Ethical also announced the appointment of Celltech Group Plc chief executive Peter Fellner as a non-executive director.
